overview.idleHint: Start the replay buffer to keep the last moments ready to save.

capture.title: Capture
capture.hint: Plain screen capture. Nothing is injected into games.
capture.apiHint: Game window records the fullscreen game in front, like Game DVR: smooth even when the game bypasses the desktop. Otherwise the whole monitor is recorded.

priorityHint.game: The game keeps full GPU priority. Best in-game FPS; under heavy load a few clip frames may repeat.
priorityHint.recording: The recorder is boosted on the GPU and CPU. Smoothest clips, at some cost to in-game FPS.

output.title: Output
output.hint: Clips come out at {w}×{h} ({aspect}). The width follows your monitor, so ultrawide stays ultrawide: no black bars.

encoder.title: Encoder
encoder.hint: Only encoders that work on this PC are listed.
encoder.noneFound: No working encoder was found. Check that the FFmpeg DLLs are next to the app.
encoder.deviceHint: GPU barely touches game performance; CPU gives the most control.

rate.title: Rate control

modeHint.vbr: Variable bitrate: average target with a peak cap.
modeHint.cqp: Constant QP: fixed quality, size varies.
modeHint.crf: Constant rate factor: constant visual quality, size varies.

rate.qualityHint: Lower is better quality and bigger files.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.hint: Encoder tuning. The defaults are fine for most people.
advanced.presetHint: Faster presets use less power, slower ones compress better.
advanced.keyframeHint: Clips start on a keyframe, so shorter means more exact clip starts.
advanced.bframesHint: 0 is safest for every player and editor.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.hint: Every track is saved separately in the clip, ready for your editor.
tracks.systemHint: Everything you hear, except this app's own sounds.
tracks.separateHint: Give each app that makes sound its own track.
tracks.defaultRuleHint: What happens with an app the first time it makes sound.

mixModeHint.apps: Every app gets its own channel with its own volume, mixed into one stereo track with your mic.
mixModeHint.loopback: One capture of everything you hear. Per-app volume then only affects apps on their own track.

apps.title: Apps making sound
apps.hint: One row per app (by exe name). Settings you change are saved for that exe and come back next time.
apps.disabled: Separate apps is off, so everything goes into the system mix only.
apps.emptyHint: Apps show up here as soon as they make a sound.
apps.loopbackVolume: "Everything" mix: these volumes only change apps that have their own track.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.hint: Record your voice along with the game.
mic.ownTrackHint: Off: the mic is mixed into the system track.
mic.gateHint: Mutes the mic below this level.
mic.meterHint: Stay quiet for a moment and watch the grey bars, then drag the yellow line just above them. When you talk, the bars should turn green.
mic.meterNoMic: Turn the microphone on to see its level
mic.suppressionHint: Removes keyboard, fan and background noise before the gate. RNNoise is an AI denoiser.
mic.strengthHint: 100% removes the most noise; lower keeps more of your natural voice.
mic.meterRemoved: {db} dB of noise removed right now. Faint bars in the graph below are your raw input.

encoding.title: Audio encoding
encoding.bitrateHint: 160 kbps is plenty for game audio.

length.title: Replay length
length.hint: How far back a saved clip reaches.

estimate.note: At {w}×{h}, {fps} FPS with the current encoder settings.
estimate.approxNote: Quality-based modes have no fixed bitrate, so this is a rough guess. Fast action scenes come out bigger.

buffer.title: Buffer
buffer.hint: Where the recording waits until you save it.
buffer.diskHint: Uses almost no RAM. Short segments rotate in the cache folder.

output.title: Saving
output.hint: Where clips go and what they are called.
output.containerHint: MP4 plays everywhere; MKV survives crashes mid-save.

clips.title: Recent clips
clips.emptyHint: Press {key} while the replay buffer is live.

hotkeys.title: Hotkeys
hotkeys.hint: Global shortcuts. They work inside games too.
hotkeys.saveClipHint: Saves the replay buffer to a clip.
hotkeys.toggleBufferHint: Turns the replay buffer on or off.
hotkeys.openWindowHint: Brings this window to the front.

app.title: Application
app.autostartHint: Launches into the tray when you log in.
app.startBufferHint: Begin buffering as soon as the app opens.

feedback.title: Save feedback
feedback.hint: How you know a clip was saved.
feedback.soundHint: Only you hear it: it is never recorded into clips.

overlay.savingHint: Writing the replay buffer to disk.
